title: WaterColor 30 Watercolor Blvd N #202
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: *Per Watercolor HOA, please include all guests aged 5 and older in your total count of adult guests to receive amenity and pool access wristbands. Sleep arrangements are provided as a courtesy and are not considered in the occupancy count.**This home is allowed 4 amenity access bands.**- Located in the center of WaterColor, overlooking Cerulean Park- Jetted Tub- Washer/Dryer- New Kitchen Appliances- 2 adult bikes provided- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers are, laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Relax in the center of town in this Caribbean-inspired haven with accommodations for 4 overlooking Cerulean Park. Dark rattan and island green furnishings against creamy walls and light wood floors create an upscale coastal atmosphere. The living room is furnished with a pale khaki sofa, pair of comfortable chairs, and antiqued sage armoire housing a flatscreen TV. The adjacent guest room has a queen sofa sleeper and enjoys access to the furnished screened balcony with park views. The primary suite contains a queen bed and teak armoire housing a smart tv. Its private bath features a deep, jetted tub and single vanity. The kitchen has warm-toned cabinets, granite countertops, and stainless appliances. There's room for 2 at the breakfast bar, with dining for 6 at the nearby table. The second bath is equipped with a walk-in shower and single vanity. Open and screened balconies offer great vantage points for relaxing in this multi-family residence in the center of town.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: -Primary Bedroom: Queen Bedroom, Private Bathroom With Jetted Tub/Shower-Additional Sleeping Area: Queen Sleeper SofaWATERCOLOR NEIGHBORHOOD HIGHLIGHTS:- Named the #1 Family Vacation Destination in the U.S.- A 499-acre coastal resort and residential community- Ideal bike community perfect for Family Getaways- Pristine sugar sand beaches- 6 swimming pools- Award-winning tennis facilities- Championship golf nearby- World Famous Beach Club- Unparalleled beachside, poolside, and lakeside dining- Acres of parks, gardens, and footpaths- Nearby state parks and preserves*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments, as well as be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.*Watercolor Community HOA prohibits the rental of Low-Speed Vehicles for guests staying in the Town Center.
